name: FitnessLLM AI Dev Container
postCreateCommand: if [ -f "/var/service_accounts.json" ]; then SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_AI=$(jq -r .service_account_email /var/service_accounts.json); if [ -n "$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_AI" ] && [ "$SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_AI" != "null" ]; then gcloud auth activate-service-account $SERVICE_ACCOUNT_EMAIL_AI; else echo 'WARNING: No valid service account configured in JSON. Skipping gcloud authentication.'; fi; else echo 'WARNING: Service accounts JSON file not found. Skipping gcloud authentication.'; fi
